cells.remarks: Records that the regions around Yādavadurga and Drōṇāchala having become deserted, the king proclaimed the settlement and offered that the people should go and settle there and that in response to this, people from Guddili, Billakalu, Bāyala, Mānukōṭi, etc., approached the king and secured the right of the settlement for Daḍḍi-Kōṭakoṇḍa which was one of the regions thrown open for settlement. cells.remarks: This spurious record, in characters of the 10th century, registers a royal gift of the village Ammaṇikā along with the villages Būḍagāḷige, Muguḷikoḍu, Bennevaḍa and Eṇḍegoḍu situated in Koṇḍanūr-viṣaya, free from taxes, to Chāvuṇḍa-chatur-vēdi-bhaṭṭa of the Kausika-gōtra, Āśvalāyana-sūtra and Hārīta gōtra respectively. The gift was made at the request of the chief queen, by the king from his Vijaya-skandhāvāra at Banavāsi. He is stated to have been the son of Simhavarman and grandson of Śarvavarman. Mahā sandhivigrahī Guṇavarman wrote the record. Noticed in Progress of Kannada Research in Bombay State (1947-52), pp. 17-18.

The descendants of the grantee, viz. Jālagāra Mālappa, shall enjoy the benefits of the gift. While detailing the boundaries of the gift-land, mentions the kaṣba of Rāja Subānajrāya Mohare.

The gift was entrusted to Apaṇji-paṇḍita of Vasiṣṭha-gōtra, Āśvalāyana-sūtra and Ṛik-śākhā.

The gift was made on the banks of the Tuṅgabhadrā in the Hari-kēri maṇḍala on Āṣāḍha ba. 30, obviously of the same year.

The gift was made for the merit of the king and of god Chennakēśavasvāmī of Bēḷūpuri, on the banks of the Vishṇusamudra on the occasion of the lunar eclipse for the propitiation of god Veṅkaṭēśvara.

The chief of Kōjāla who was to enjoy the same hereditarily and perform the worship of the deity. The chief is stated to be the son of the Śivappa-nāyaka and grandson of Sōmanātha-nāyaka, a nāyaka of Pūval-sarvaya, and a devotee of god Rāmacandra of Santebennūr.

cells.location: MYSORE STATE / SOUTH KANARA DISTRICT / UDIPI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: No. 6
cells.remarks: Registers an endowment of 250 Dhārarāda-gadyāna to the bhānādāra of god Krishnadēva of Udupi, worshipped by the religious heads of the ashta-saṭhīthāna who were the followers of the sampradāya of Śrīmad-Ānandatīrtha-āchārya. The gift was made by Savundrarāja-paṇdita, the pradhāna of Mysore, son of Bhadrayya and grandson of Vīranayya of Gautama-gōtra, Āśvalāyana-sūtra and Rik-śākhā, for performing the worship of the god on Madhva-navami day every year with the interest accruing at the rate of one varūha per ten per annum. The details of the services to the god on this day are enumerated. The endowment was made during the period of Raghuvaryatīrtha-śrīpāda who was then in charge of the worship of the god.

cells.remarks: Records the obeisance of Mahāmatha Vyāsa Devarāja belonging to the Mōḍhānvaya. In characters of about the 11th century.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH · MADHYA PRADESH † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Second side of the same pillar
cells.remarks: Records the obeisance of Dēvapati, son of Sādha Sōḍhala. Do.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH · MADHYA PRADESH † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Broken slab in a Fakīr's house in the Fort.
cells.remarks: Damaged and fragmentary. Seems to contain a praśasti of which verse No. 3 ends in line 6. Do.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH · MADHYA PRADESH † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Railing pillar excavated near the Kham-bābā.
cells.remarks: In shell characters.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH · MADHYA PRADESH — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Railing pillar excavated near the Kham-bābā.
cells.remarks: In shell characters.

cells.location: MADRAS NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT ARANI DIVISION · MADRAS NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT ARANI DIVISION Kallippaṭṭu — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Saptakanni temple. Slab built into the east wall.
cells.date: Śaka 1791 (current), Vibhava, Kārttigai 27, Śvāti, Thursday = 1868 A.D., December 10.
cells.remarks: Records that the garbhagṛiha etc. of the temple were built and consecrated by Pūmālai-mudaliyār of Kāñchīpuram and Durgāchala-mudaliyār of Chengaṇiputtu for Kaṇṇi-amman, their family deity.

cells.location: MADRAS NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT ARANI DIVISION · Māmaṇḍūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Sōmanāthēśvara temple. Base tier of the south wall of the central shrine.
cells.king: Bommu-nāyaka †
cells.remarks: Middle portion built in. Records the gift of lands in the village Māvaṇḍūr alias Rājaśēkhara-Karpūrapuram as dēvabhōga by Bommu-nāyaka, the ruler of Vēlūr, for conducting the daily worship and services to the deity Sōmanāthadēva, for the merit of his father Nāgama-nāyakkar-aiyan. It is said that the above village, situated on the north side of the Kuṉṟavardhana-kōṭṭam, a division in Paḍavīḍu rājya included in the Jayankoṇḍaśōla-maṇḍalam, was purchased by the donor from the mahājanas of the village and granted. Paḍavīḍu is described as the rājadhānī of Āraṇi-rājya. The donor is described as the son of Nāgama and the grandson of Tippu-nāyaka.

cells.location: MADRAS NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT ARANI DIVISION · Māmaṇḍūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up on the bank of a tank called Periyēri.
cells.date: Śaka 1514, Nandana, Makara ba. 15, Monday, Śravaṇa = 1593 A.D., January 22.

cells.location: MADRAS NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT ARANI DIVISION · Puṇalappāḍi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up near the Māriyammaṇ temple.
cells.date: Šaka 1515, Vijaya, Makara ba. 2, Saturday, Pushya=1593 A.D., Deçember 29.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of lands in the village Poñpilapāđi to the same deity Kailāsanāthasvāmi of Ārani for the same purpose by the same donor, viz., Bommu-nāyaka, as in No. 179 above. It is said that the gift village, situated to the south of the river Kunriyāru in Murugamaṅgalaf*jparru in Tachehūnādu in Palkuṇrak-kōṭtam, was purchased by the donor from the mahājanas of Poñpilapparru alias Tirumaladēvi-puram and that the gift was made for the merit of his father Nāgamanāyekar-ayyaṇ on the day of the Makaru-sañkrānti.

cells.location: MADRAS NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT ARANI DIVISION · Vāṇiyambāḍi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Athiśvara temple, ardha maṇḍapa, jamb stones on either side of the entrance.
cells.dynasty: Pārthivēndrādhi[pati*]varmaṇ, took the head of Virapāṇdya.
cells.remarks: Records the sale of land with exemption from taxes to Cōḷi Tāmaṇan by the sabhā of Vāṇiyambāḍi alias Narasiṃhachaturvēdimangalam in Aḍaiyāru-nāḍu in Paḍuvūr-kōṭṭam. The land was purchased by him for the purpose of burning a lamp for Virumādēvi-īśvaramuḍaiyār, the Mahādēva of the village. The sabhā is stated to have received some money from him towards the price of the land and the tax-exemption granted.

cells.location: MADRAS NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT ARANI DIVISION · Vāṇiyambāḍi † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Central shrine, south wall
cells.remarks: Records the grant of Viḷḷikandāraman alias Alagiyāśōlanallūr in the northern division of Vāṇiyambāḍi along with some other lands by the sabhā, Vīraśōla-caturvēdimangalam alias Ediriliśōlach-chambuva-rāyan for maintaining two perpetual lamps, and conducting the Alagiyāśōlan sandhi and a festival in the temple of Tiruvīraśōla-īśvaramuḍaiyār in Vāṇiyambāḍi, alias Madhurāntakach-chaturvēdimangalam.

cells.location: MADRAS NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT ARANI DIVISION · Vāṇiyambāḍi † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Second prākāra, north wall
cells.remarks: Commences with the praśasti, Pugaļmādu vilaṅga, etc. of the king. Records the grant of land on the south bank of Pālāru, purchased from the sabhaiyār of Vāniyanpāđi alias Madhurāntakach-chaturvēdimaṅgalam in Aimpulugūr-nādu in Perumbānappāđi, by Palljikondāṇ Kūttaṇ alias Nandiyarāyaṇ of Sirrāmūr in Rājanārāyaṇa-vaļanādu for (1) the supply of a flower canopy in the Vinnājantiruvōlakkam, (2) supplying oil for lamps, (3) offering of sweet rice-cakes to the deity, (4) parivaṭtam for the Māhēśvaras and (5) the daily feeding of the latter on festival days.

cells.location: MADRAS NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT ARANI DIVISION · Vāṇiyambāḍi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Second prākāra, north wall
cells.remarks: Records the undertaking given by the Śivabrāhmaṇas of the temple to burn a perpetual lamp, to god Tiruvindūḍēvar having received 96 sheep from Bhūmidēvan, son of Kaṇṇanḍai Vīraśōlan-kūttan of Vāḷaippāṇḍal in Vāḷaippāṇḍal-nāḍu in Paḷkuṇra-kōṭṭam.

cells.location: MADRAS NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT ARANI DIVISION · Vāṇiyambāḍi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Second prākāra, north wall
cells.remarks: Records the gift of 10 cows and 1 bull entrusted to the Śivabrāhmanas of toṇvāru-vaṭtam for 3 sandhi lamps for god Viṭukādalagiśvaram-udāyiār by Vijaiyanallulāṇ Śingaṇ Ājudaiyāṇ Nulambarāyaṇ of Arumbākkam in Tirumuṇaipāđi-nādu. The donor is stated to have caused the construction of a shrine upto the stūpī for the deity. A postscript records an undertaking given by the Śivabrāhmanas in respect of 1½ pop received from Kūttādum-pilāi, son of Urāṇdai for a sandhi lamp to the same deity.

cells.location: MADRAS NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT ARANI DIVISION · Vāṇiyambāḍi † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: East wall
cells.remarks: Records that all the tiruvilakkappatti lands of god Virundin-nāyanār in Vāṇiyambāḍi alias Madhurāntakach-chaturvēdimangalam in Aimpuli-gūr-kōṭṭam and the dēvadāna lands in other areas were made sarvamānya with the power to collect the taxes, etc., by Iramaṇa Dēpāya-yakkan for worship and various services.

cells.location: MADRAS / NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUVANNAMALAI TALUK · MADRAS—contd. / NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT—concld. / TIRUVANNAMALAI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Kāriyandai.—Stone set up on the way to the chēri.
cells.remarks: States that this is the śirumuri according to which an endal (namolost) was given to Puluguneypperumāl alius, Nāvilangādapillai as kāniyāṭchi. Lays down the kađurmai dues on the land according to the crops and seasons. A sum of 10 payum is referred to as the amount realised by an auction (Chandēśvarup-peruvilai). In characters of about the 15th century.

cells.location: MADRAS / NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUVANNAMALAI TALUK · TIRUVANNAMALAI TALUK NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up to the south of the village
cells.remarks: Records the conferment, as kāṇi, of the land on the borders of Aḍaiyūr and Vongaikkal in Aṇṇā-nāḍu on Kūṭṭāḍuvār-kār-āḷar, the descendants of the sons of Kāḷingārāyar, & Sāḷikkāṭu. See No. 189 below. Do.

cells.location: MADRAS / NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUVANNAMALAI TALUK · TIRUVANNAMALAI TALUK NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rock to the south of the village
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records a similar transaction as in No. 188 above conferring the kāṇiyāṭchi in this case on Aṇṇāmalai-Sāḷiyadārai-yar. A sum of 15 paṇam is stated to be the Chaṇḍēśvar-pperuvilai. Do.

cells.location: MADRAS / NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUVANNAMALAI TALUK · Veṅgāya-Vēlūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab set up in a street in the village.
cells.remarks: Depicts a yantra with some letters in squares. In lato charac-ters.

cells.location: MADRAS / NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUVANNAMALAI TALUK · Vēṭṭavalam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rīmanāthasvāmi temple, rock surface inside the store-room.
cells.remarks: States that this is a śāsana drawn up on royal orders endow-ing the village Vēṭṭavalam in Siṅgamalapparru on Vēṭṭavaippar along with the income from taxes including Vāśal-kaṭṭāyam/Vaḷḷuvar-kāśikkaṭṭai. In characters of the 14th century.

cells.location: MADRAS / NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUVANNAMALAI TALUK · Vēṭṭavalam † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rock surface inside the prākāra
cells.date: Regnal year 16. Rishabha śu. 5. Monday, Magham-1284 A.D., May 22. (The tiṭhi ended at 29 on the previous day).
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records a tax-free grant of land to Rīmanāthadēvan by the king from his camp at Siṅgamalai in Siṅgamalapparru in Teṅgamalai-nāḍu.

cells.location: MADRAS / NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUVANNAMALAI TALUK · Vēṭṭavalam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rock surface inside the prākāra
cells.remarks: Do. Seems to record a grant by Kīḷiyūr Malaiyaṇān to god Tiruvagaṭṭīśvaramuḍaiyār in Miḷāḍu alias Jananāthapuram in-cluding the village of Pūṇḍi on the northern bank of the river Peṇṇai. In characters of about the 12th century.

cells.location: MADRAS / NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUVANNAMALAI TALUK · Vēṭṭavalam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rock surface inside the prākāra
cells.remarks: Do. Mentions Vēṭṭavalam. Do.

cells.location: MADRAS / NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUVANNAMALAI TALUK · Vēṭṭavalam † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rock to the north of the village
cells.remarks: Records the assignment of Aṇukkumalai in Śiṅgāmalaippaṟṟu to Vāṇādharāyan as taṇḍēṟu-irayiṟai from the year Vikāri for bringing the lands cultivated and for settling several families.

cells.location: MADRAS / NORTH ARCOT DISTRICT / TIRUVANNAMALAI TALUK · Vēṭṭavalam † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Rock to the west of Śiṅgārakulam
cells.remarks: Records that this tank and the one to its north were the benefactions of Tiruvēṅgaḍamuḍaiyāṉ of Tiruvallam in Toṇḍaimāṇ-āṟṟūr alias Tiruvikkirama-chaturvēdimaṅgalam. In characters of about the 13th century.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT SAIDAPET TALUK · CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT SAIDAPET TALUK St. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Thomas Mount.—Slab built into the Vināyaka temple in the East Chetti Street.
cells.remarks: Records the grant of the two houses, No. 330 in the eastern row and No. 333 in the western row in the Puducheţti street in the cantonment in Parangimalai and two shops (Nos. 67 and 68) in Malaikadai street by Murugappa-chettiyār of Ainavanna-mahārishi-gōtram to god Sundara-vināyakar in 1902 A.D., September 22, equivalent to Šubhakrit, Puratţūśi 7, and the taking up of the duties hereditarily as dharmakartiţe of the said temple by the donor.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT SAIDAPET TALUK / SHRPERUMBUDUR TALUK · SHRPERUMBUDUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Māṅgāḍu.—Perumāḷ temple in the village. Central shrine, north wall, base tier.
cells.remarks: Records the gift of 90 sheep for a perpetual lamp to the deity at Kalikēśari-vishṇugṛiham in Māṅgāḍu alias Alagiyāśōlanallūr by a native (name lost) of Neḍuvāyil. In characters of about the 11th century.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT SAIDAPET TALUK / SHRPERUMBUDUR TALUK · Śrīperumbūdūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Bhūtapatīśvara temple. South wall of the Ammaṉ shrine.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Appears to record a transaction made by the mahāsabhai of ... regarding the boundaries of the dēvadāna lands of god Tiru-Agnīśvaramuḍaiyār.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT SAIDAPET TALUK / SHRPERUMBUDUR TALUK · Śrīperumbūdūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall
cells.remarks: Do. Appears to be a part of a record similar to No. 199 above connected with the dēvadāna lands of god ...dirachōḷa-uḍaiyār.

cells.location: CHINGLEPUT DISTRICT SAIDAPET TALUK / SHRPERUMBUDUR TALUK · Śrīperumbūdūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine in the same temple. Stone used as the lintel of the entrance.
cells.remarks: Do. Seems to refer to a gift probably of some land for the food-offerings to the image of god Bhūtīśvarattu-āḻvār. In characters of about the 11th century.

cells.location: COIMBATORE DISTRICT / AVANASHI TALUK · COIMBATORE DISTRICT / AVANASHI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Avaṇāśi.—Pedestal of the image of Māṇikkavāchakar.
cells.remarks: Records that Gōdāvaridēvī arranged for a feast on the occasion of the marriage of Śrī Bhuvanēśvarīdēvī, the daughter of Mahārāyar, at the Navaratna[-maṇḍapa] for the propitiation of god Avināśidēvar. The image was apparently donated on the occasion. In late characters.

cells.location: COIMBATORE DISTRICT / AVANASHI TALUK · Karavalūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Sundararājaperumāḷ temple, central shrine, south wall, base.
cells.remarks: Records the royal order to the authorities of the temple granting the tank for the Karavalūr along with the lands irrigated by it, for the expenses of the worship and for burning lamps to god Vararājēndra-viṇṇagar-emberumāṉ of Palaṅkaruvalūr in Vaḍapariśāra-nāḍu. The regnal year 20 is mentioned in the body of the inscription. In characters of about the 13th century.

cells.location: COIMBATORE DISTRICT / AVANASHI TALUK · MADRAS — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: contd. COIMBATORE DISTRICT—contd. AVANASHI TALUK—contd. Paḻaṅgarai.—Ciṭṭīśvarasvāmi temple, central shrine, north wall.
cells.remarks: Records the gift of the 48 kaḻañju of paddy due to them from the ūrār of Vīranārāyaṇanallūr alias Kuruṅkuḷi annually to god Āḷuḍaiyār Muṇṭoṉṟuṇḍīśvarar of their village by a body at Āvaṉāśi. The ūrār of the village is requested to measure out the paddy as stipulated and also to feed the person deputed to collect the paddy. In characters of the 13th century.

cells.location: COIMBATORE DISTRICT / AVANASHI TALUK · MADRAS — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: contd. COIMBATORE DISTRICT—contd. AVANASHI TALUK—contd. Paḻaṅgarai.—Ciṭṭīśvarasvāmi temple, central shrine, north wall.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Refers to the measuring out of paddy as in No. 204 above. Do.

cells.location: COIMBATORE DISTRICT / AVANASHI TALUK · MADRAS † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West and south wall
cells.remarks: Continuation of lines lost. Records an undertaking given appa-rently by the ūrār and ūraḷar to contribute annually certain quantity of paddy as specified for offerings to the god Āḷuḍaiyār of the varamūḍaiyār, the god of their village, having received money in āṇai achchu śirīpāda paṇam [lakṣa] from the interest on some ... kan of the kaikōḷar community for the purpose. Do.

cells.location: COIMBATORE DISTRICT / AVANASHI TALUK · MADRAS † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: South wall, tiers
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record an undertaking given by a body to provide for food-offerings to a deity from the interest on some sum of achchu deposited by an individual probably from Chēyūr.

cells.location: COIMBATORE DISTRICT / AVANASHI TALUK · MADRAS † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone set up in the garden of the temple
cells.remarks: Records the apportionment of the produce from the lands irrigated by Chāḷiśvaram-vāykkāl among the gods of the village by Liṅgaṇa-uḍaiyar to the north east of the Āviṉāśiliṅgan temple and to the east of Vālasamudram, in equal shares to the god Āviṉāśi, to god Vālasamudram, to god of the ūr, to Liṅgaṇa-uḍaiyar, by Paḻayaruṇakkār in the service of Vālasyadeva mahārāja and the sthānīkar. Vālasamudram is stated to have been constructed by Vālasamudrai-uḍaiyar after his own name. In characters of about the 15th century.

cells.location: COIMBATORE DISTRICT / AVANASHI TALUK · MADRAS † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Another stone in the same place
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the gift of land to Palangarai for Śivapūjā in the Chokka-Sūnasambandhavalla-pandāramaṭha at Avināśi by Śrimadu Tēmāsayyad, the pūrapattiyam of Rājarājapuram in Koṅgu, a Davnāyakkar (name lost) and the nāṭīr and kāniyāṭar of Vadapariśāra-nādu. Varadappanpargaṭ is stated to have been the royal agent.

cells.location: COIMBATORE DISTRICT / AVANASHI TALUK · MADRAS † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Stone near the Saṅgama tank
cells.date: Śaka 1464, Nandana, Chittirai 5. (The Śaka year was 1454).
cells.remarks: Records the gift of land to god Avināśilingaṇ by Pagavarnāyakkar and the sthānikr mentioned in No. 208 above. Koṅgumaṇdalam is stated to be under the administration of Vānāda-udaiyar, described as the right-hand of Timmappadapāyakkaṇ.

cells.location: COIMBATORE DISTRICT / AVANASHI TALUK · Rāmānāthapuram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: West wall of the dilapidated Vēṇugōpālasvāmi temple.
cells.remarks: Records the name Paintangi Nāgabhaṭṭu Ayya. A sketch of the garuḍa curse is drawn in outline to the right of the writing. In late characters.

cells.location: COIMBATORE DISTRICT / AVANASHI TALUK · Dēvārayapuram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Veṅkaṭēśaperumāḷ temple, north wall.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to record some transaction (details lost) of the dharmakartas of the temple and mentions the grāmattār and Chellapperumāl.

cells.location: COIMBATORE DISTRICT / AVANASHI TALUK · Dēvārayapuram † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same wall.
cells.date: Kali 4858, Īśvara, Chittirai 15, Sunday = 1757 A.D., April 24.
cells.remarks: Damaged and fragmentary. Seems to record some transaction (details lost) in respect of god Veṅkaṭēśa-perumāḷ of Mēlait-Tirupati ābes Viṣṇuguri-Rudragiri, situated in Mēlai-Cōḻamaṇḍalam in Toṇḍaimaṇḍalam in Vaḍa-karṇai-Pērūr-nāḍu.

cells.location: COIMBATORE DISTRICT / AVANASHI TALUK · Ottaikkāḷmaṇḍapam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Broken slab in the compound of the Navakōṭinārāyaṇa-svāmi temple.
cells.date: Kali 4695, Pārthiva, Arpaśi 15. (The Kali and the cyclic years do not agree).
cells.remarks: Records the the mallamāi levied at specified places for the temple. Being the original foundation of the Navakōṭinārāyaṇapperumāḷ by the merchant-guild of the 56 countries to the same deity by Kayilāsappa-nāyakkar Mallappa-nāyakkar for the merit of Virappa-nāyakkar.

cells.location: COIMBATORE DISTRICT / AVANASHI TALUK · Ottaikkāḷmaṇḍapam † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Samo slab
cells.remarks: Badly damaged except for the imprecatory portion. Mentions Oṭṭaikar-maṇḍapa[m]. Koṇḍarāja figures as a signatory. In characters of the 16th century.

cells.location: COIMBATORE DISTRICT / AVANASHI TALUK · Ottaikkāḷmaṇḍapam † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Slab in front of the Aghōravīrabhadra temple on the roadside.
cells.remarks: Badly damaged. Seems to refer to a grant of ½ paṇam per load of merchandise to the deity Māṇikka... of Vijayamangalam by the merchants of the 56 countries. Do.

cells.location: COIMBATORE DISTRICT / AVANASHI TALUK · Akhilāṇḍapuram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Agastyēśvara temple, north wall, tiers.
cells.remarks: Refers to the construction of a trough for nirmāḷya (?) in the temple of Agastīśvara by Veḷḷāḷan Soṅgaṇippiḷḷan Śrāmān-tōḷan Toṇḍaimān. In characters of the 14th century.

cells.location: COIMBATORE DISTRICT / AVANASHI TALUK · Akhilāṇḍapuram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Agastyēśvara temple, north wall, tiers.
cells.remarks: Records an endowment of one paṇam per month for food offerings during nights to god Agastīśvaram-uḍaiyār of their village by the ūr and the ārāḷigaḷ of Kāngēyam. Do.

cells.location: COIMBATORE DISTRICT / AVANASHI TALUK · Akhilāṇḍapuram † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Same temple, west wall, tiers
cells.remarks: Records that the maṇḍapa in the ardhamanḍapa of the temple was caused to be made by Puḷiyamman, the wife of Sōmanātha-dēvar and mother of the temple-builder Kurumbāḷar in Paṭṭaḷi. In characters of the 13th century.

cells.location: COIMBATORE DISTRICT / AVANASHI TALUK · Akhilāṇḍapuram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Do. south wall, tiers
cells.remarks: Built in at the right end. Records that the tirunilai-kāl, etc., of the ardhamanḍapa were donated by Piḷḷan Piḷḷaiyāḷvi Āḷvi alias Pirāṇḍi-perumāḷmīn who is said to have belonged to the group called Aṇḍaiyī of the Veḷḷāḷa community. Do.

cells.location: COIMBATORE DISTRICT / AVANASHI TALUK · Akhilāṇḍapuram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Do. south wall, tiers
cells.remarks: Do. Records the donation of the door-frame (tirunilaikkāl) of the garbhagṛiha in the temple by Sōyvālvi-periyadēvan alias Toṇḍai... belonging to the group called kaḷar-var eḍaiyār. Do.

cells.location: MADRAS / COIMBATORE DISTRICT / DHARAPURAM TALUK · MADRAS—contd / COIMBATORE DISTRICT—concld / DHARAPURAM TALUK—concld — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Akhiliāpāpuram.—concld.

cells.location: MADRAS / COIMBATORE DISTRICT / DHARAPURAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Agastyēivara temple. Slab set up near the school.
cells.date: Kali 4633, Nandana, Mūģi 5, 6u. 5, Thursday, Rēvati—1533 A.D., January 30.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record an endowment of some land irrigated by Periyavāykkāl which was fed by the waters of the three ponds called Senguḷam, Vaṇṇāṇvāvi and Āṇḍichcha-kuṭṭai to god Tiruvālanduṟai-uḍaiyār by the ūrāvar of Akhilāṇḍapuram and ...-vikku-nallāleyār who met for this purpose in the Tērvāru-maṇḍapa. Mentions Vālaiyādēva-mahārāja as the local governor and as the 'right-hand man' of Timma-daṇāyaka, the agent of the king. Cf. No. 210 above.

cells.remarks: Records a gift of one achchu paid to Tiruvaṁbala-nambi and Piḷḷan Poṇṇambala-nambi for maintaining a lamp for Chaṇḍēśvaradēva by ...-uḍaiyāṇ alias ...-uḍaiyāṇ of ...-uḍaiyāṇ the shrine for the same by Milāḍuḍaiyāṇ Periyankaṇ-iṇiyār, a merchant of Veḷḷūr alias Koḍumuḍi-ārapuram in Āmūr-nāḍu. cells.location: MADRAS / COIMBATORE DISTRICT / ERODE TALUK · Nāśiyanūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Mūvēndēśvara temple. Tiers of the main shrine.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Refers to the construction of various parts of the temple including the gōpura and records that the temple land was exempted from specified taxes for daily worship and offerings and festivals in the temple probably by a body who had met for the purpose in the maṇimaṇḍapam. In late characters.

cells.location: MADRAS / COIMBATORE DISTRICT / ERODE TALUK · Nāśiyanūr † — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Do. Records a grant, the details of which are lost, and mentions Kempaya, a tiruvāykōḷ of the prince and god Mūvēndira-muḍaiyār-nāyaṉār. In characters of the 15th century. See No. 231 Below.

cells.location: MADRAS / COIMBATORE DISTRICT / ERODE TALUK · Nāśiyanūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Pillar in the same shrine
cells.remarks: States that Tirumalaiyātha-Goppaṇan, the rājyādhikāri of Tiruvēkkūr, endowed two pillars during the construction of the garbhagṛiha, ardha-maṇḍapa and mahā-maṇḍapa of the temple of Mūvēndira-muḍaiyār Tambirānār at Nasaiyāṉūr. The endowment was made by the order of the king's agent, Perraporumāḷ Amaipperichār of the Veḷḷāḷar Kaṇṇagaṇ. See Nos. 227 and 228 Above.

cells.location: MADRAS / COIMBATORE DISTRICT / ERODE TALUK · Nāśiyanūr † — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: MADRAS / COIMBATORE DISTRICT / ERODE TALUK · Sāttambūr — Tamil Nadu

Stipulates that those who interfered with this would forfeit the right to protection and compen-sation for their lives. In characters of about the 12th century.

cells.location: MADRAS / COIMBATORE DISTRICT / ERODE TALUK · Sāttambūr † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Tiers of the base, south side, same temple
cells.remarks: Reads: [Buṭṭanar.] In late characters.

cells.location: MADURAI DISTRICT · Ulagāpi — Tamil Nadu

Vijayadēvadēvaṉ figures as the signatory of the record. In characters of about the 13th century.

cells.location: MADURAI DISTRICT · Ulagāpi † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Ruined temple of Īśvara, Ammaṉ shrine, door-jamb.
cells.remarks: Fragment. Mentions Āṭkoṇḍavilli alias Miṇavadaraiyan. Do.

cells.location: MADURAI DISTRICT · Vikkiramangalam † — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Records the death of Perumāḷi Chiruṅgai-pollikāran, son of Nirkuli-pallikāran, probably after killing a tiger. In characters of about the 12th century. The sculpture on the slab depicts a man attacking a tiger and being received by celestial damsels.

cells.location: NILGIRIS DISTRICT COONOOR TALUK · NILGIRIS DISTRICT COONOOR TALUK Hāṭṭaṭṭai (near Mēṭūr) † — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: In two fragments. Records the allotment of lands as sarvamānya to several Brāhmaṇas probably by Rāvuṭṭa Vīra-Nārāyaṇa-Rāya... ...Mākkuttūr-chaturvēdimaṅgalam.

In characters of about the 15th century.

cells.location: TANJAVUR DISTRICT / NAGAPATTANAM TALUK · Nāgūr — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: TANJAVUR DISTRICT / TANJAVUR TALUK · TANJAVUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu

cells.place: Stones built into the walls of the prākāra

Mentions Tiruchchirambalamāḷir, Tamuḻiṭṭu-vēḷār and Nāṭṭiyavaram-uḍaiyār. In characters of about the 13th century

cells.location: TIRUNELVELI DISTRICT / SRIVAIKUNTAM TALUK · SRIVAIKUNTAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: TIRUNELVELI DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Refers to a grant of kuḍimai rights with exemption from certain levies such as māḍāpatyam etc. by some members of the Nāḍār community of Marudūrmalaivaṭṭam in Māṅgāḍu to several persons viz., Viśvanātha-nāyakkar, Vīrappa-nāyakkar, Pichcha-pillai and several others, Mentions Cheṭṭikōyil.

cells.location: TIRUNELVELI DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · Kulaśēkharapaṭṭaṇam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Kachchikonda-pāṇḍīśvara temple, central shrine, south wall, tiers.
cells.remarks: States that this pāḍal was caused to be constructed by Periyaṉ and contains the signature of viḻudaich chaṅmugapperumāḷ. In characters of about the 13th century.

cells.location: TIRUNELVELI DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · Kulaśēkharapaṭṭaṇam — Tamil Nadu

cells.place: Slab near the Dargah of Hazrat Bagh Sawar. Do.

cells.remarks: Records the grant of land, flower-garden, oil-mill etc., for the worship of the deity Kēśavadēva and for carrying out repairs etc., in the temple made on the occasion of the installation of the deity by Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Āhavamallarasar at Biḍi-Dālimba, a village situated in the division of Twelve which was under his administration. Also records grants of lands to a number of individuals who included binnāṇi Rēvōja who had built the temple of Kēśavadēva.

cells.location: MAHARASHTRA / NAGPUR DISTRICT / OMERGA TALUK · Murum — Maharashtra
cells.place: Slab, city-gate. Do.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary and incomplete. Seems to record a grant of land. Refers to a feudatory (name lost) who was probably ruling from rājadhāni Moramba. In characters of the 11th century.

cells.location: MAHARASHTRA / NAGPUR DISTRICT / TULJAPUR TALUK · TULJAPUR TALUK Itkal — Maharashtra
cells.place: Pillar in the Maruti temple. Do.
cells.language: Śaka 1139, Isvara, Pushya ba. 10, Monday, Uttarāyana-saṅkramana= 1217, A. D., Decomber 25.
cells.remarks: Do. . . Commences with the vachina, Ôm Jaya-paramēśvara etc., of Siddharāma. Records that Mahāpradhāna Saṅgamadēva-nāyaka, accompanied by the kumāras Jayitigidēva, Lingadēva, Ganēśvaradēva, Parigidēva and Śambhudēva, renamed the village of Attinūru as Lingāpura and made a gift of the village Ittage, situated in Āmkulage-80, a subdivision of Āṇadūra-300, as sarvanamasya to the deity Kapilasiddha-Mallikārjuna of Sohnalige. The gift was made in view of the approaching solar eclipse (Śūryagrahanada-muṇde).

cells.location: MAHARASHTRA / SATARA DISTRICT WAI TALUK · SATARA DISTRICT WAI TALUK Khāṇāpur — Maharashtra
cells.place: Slab in the village. Impression received from the Superintendent, South-Western Circle, Aurangabad.
cells.date: Śaka 1178, Nala, Mārgaśira śu. 5, Thursday. Irregular.
cells.remarks: Seems to record the gift of the town, [Kāndhalapurī].

cells.location: MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK · MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Dodda-Majūr.—Kailūsēvara temple, maṇdapa, pillar.

cells.remarks: States that this maṇḍapa was constructed by Tillaikkūttan of Kārikkuḍi. In characters of the 11th century. Published in Ep. Carn., Vol. IX, Channapatna, No. 92a.

cells.location: MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK · MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK † — Karnataka

cells.remarks: Records a grant of land for maintaining a perpetual lamp by Mahādēvan to Śrī Kayilāsamuḍaiya-mahādēvar in Maḷavūr alias Rājēndraśiṅga-ich-charuppēdimangalam. The king bears the title Mahādēvamalla. In characters of the 12th century. Ibid., No. 78.

cells.location: MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK · MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Do. South wall
cells.remarks: Records a grant of land, by purchase, made tax free probably to provide for food offerings to a god, to god Umāmahēśvara-sahitar Gaṇḍaditavittankar whose image was set up by ...yāṇ Saṅkaran Gaṇḍaditta-brahma-sēṇāpati alias Rājarāja-chōḷa-bhavanam. Cf. ibid., No. 92. In characters of about the 11th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK · MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK † — Karnataka
cells.place: Kūḍlūr.—Pond in the village, stones built into the southern side.
cells.remarks: Fragments. One fragment refers to the installation of an image of a deity and the construction of a temple at Kūḍalūr in Kōṇḍaśōḷa-maṇḍalam. Another fragment mentions Bhūm-āṇḍa-nāyakkan and a gift to god Mahādēva. The third refers to the command of the Śrīmāhēśvarar. In characters of 12th c. Cf. the inscription of the Chōḷa king, Rājēndra-paṭṇa, No. 120, where the image referred to is stated to be that of Chandrachēkhara in the temple of Maṅgalēśvaram.

cells.location: MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK · MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK † — Karnataka
cells.place: Northern side
cells.remarks: Records the gift of 3-1/2 paṇam for a sandhi lamp by Tōttan-kiḷān Saṅgaṇḍan to the god Maṅgalēśvara-uḍaiya-mahādēvar in Kūḍalūr alias Rājarāja-chaturvēdimangalam. Do. Kijai-nāḍu in Rājēndraśōḷa-maṅgalam. Do. Ibid., No. 122.

cells.location: MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK · MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Northern side
cells.remarks: Records the gift of 4 paṇam by Maṇiyāṇḍan, son of Tach-chāṇ to the god Maṅgalēśvaram alias Vallāḷēśvaram in Kūḍalūr alias Rājarāja-chaturvēdimangalam. Do.

cells.location: MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK · Borgaon — Karnataka
cells.place: Sculptured slab built into the right wall of the Jaina basti.
cells.date: Śaka 1322, Vikrama, Vaiśākha, ba. 12, Thursday, Aśvini= 1400 A.D., May 20, Thursday, f.d.t.·13.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Refers to the nisidi of Sakaḷachandradēva, the disciple of Guṇachandra-bhaṭṭāraka.

cells.location: MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK · Eksamba — Karnataka
cells.place: Stone in a field belonging to Prabhu Satappa Kumbara about four miles to the north of the village.
cells.king: Lakshmīdēvarasa †
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land by mahāpradhāna Kēśiyāṇayya-daṇḍāyaka, for feeding Brāhmaṇas in a satra, at the instance of Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Lakshmīdēvarasa.

cells.location: MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK · Sadalgi — Karnataka
cells.place: Māsti stone kept in the navaraṅga of the Maḷidēva temple.
cells.remarks: Badly damaged and worn out. Begins with Śrīman-mahā-maṇḍalēśvara [Vīra]... Purport not clear. In characters of about the 13th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK · Sēmanvādi — Karnataka
cells.place: Base of the marble Jaina image kept within the gōpura on the roof of the basti.
cells.date: Śaka 1715, Pramādi, Kārttika śu. 4, Thursday = 1793 A.D., November 7.
cells.remarks: Worn out. Mentions Jinasēna-bhaṭṭāraka.

cells.location: MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK · Umrāṇi — Karnataka
cells.place: Broken slab fixed into the wall of the Rāmaliṅga temple in the valley about 2 miles to the north of the village.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to refer to the construction of the temple and to an expenditure of a thousand [rupees] towards the same.

cells.location: MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK · Basidōṇi — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in the compound of the Dyāmavva temple.
cells.date: Śaka 14[76], Śrāvaṇa ba. 30, Monday = 1554 A.D., August 27.
cells.remarks: Damaged and broken at the bottom. Refers to a codeya probably as kārya-kartta. Further details are lost.

cells.location: MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK · Gōrēbāl — Karnataka
cells.place: Three fragments of a slab lying in the field of Channappa, Pāṭēla rupa Talara about ... mile to the south-east of the village.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Mentions Saṅgama-kaṭaka who was administering Toragale and registers gifts of land situated in the agrahāra Basidōṇi, by Kēśappa for Hūli. Refers to Gōparasa-daṇḍanāyaka.

cells.location: MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK · Maṇikaṭṭi — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying in the field of Bhimarayappa Kallur.
cells.remarks: States that 12 mattar of land belonged to (i.e. was meant for the maintenance of) the tank of Monagere. In characters of the 13th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK · Tallūr — Karnataka
cells.place: Stone kept in the wāḍā of Bapusaheb Desai.
cells.remarks: Refers to a gift of land to (i.e. for the maintenance of) Dēvajīgore of [Ta]la[tā]ri Sū[li]va[ra]sa. In characters of the 15th-16th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK · Yeḍravi — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab built into the platform in front of the Barmadēva temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged and top of the slab broken. Registers a gift of land on account of Saṅkrānti-parva to the temple (dēhara) at Eḷarime by the twelve gāvuṇḍas of the village, after laving the feet of Kanakaprabha-siddhāntadēva.

cells.location: MYSORE / BANGALORE DISTRICT / CHENNAPATNA TALUK · Nāgarbeṭṭa — Karnataka
cells.place: Loose stone slab lying near a common well in the south western corner of the village. Impression from the Superintendent, South-Western Circle, Aurangabad.
cells.remarks: Partly damaged. Records the grant of 10 mattar of black soil land by Allapulidēva who claims to be of the Yādava lineage, to the temple of Siddheśvara-purāṇēśvara, in the presence of Sandhivigrahi Subhākarayya and others. The donee is not mentioned in the record.

cells.location: MYSORE / BIJAPUR DISTRICT / SINDGI TALUK · MYSORE—contd. / BIJAPUR DISTRICT—contd. / SINDGI TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Kondguli.—Three faces of a square stone pillar found in the debris in a matha in the outekirts of the village. Impression from the Superintendent, South. Western circle, Aurangabad.
cells.date: Regnal year 7, Paridhāvi, Pushya, Paurṇamāsi, Sunday, Uttarāyana-saṁkramaṇa =1132, A.D., December 24. (The week day was Saturday).
cells.remarks: Records the gift of money (in varāha-gadyāṇa) for maintenance of lamp and Gandha-pūjā-naivēdya for the maintenance of teachers teaching different subjects like gadyatraya-saṁhitā, vyākaraṇa, etc. The gift was made to the temple of Sōmēśvara-dēva. Also records gifts of money (in kaṭṭale-gadyāṇa) by bhaṇḍārigi Bhāmadēva-nāyaka and Brahmadhiva-bhaṭṭa for tāmbūla dāna, etc. The mahājanas made a further grant of a garden for puṣpa-dāna.

cells.location: MYSORE / BIJAPUR DISTRICT / SINDGI TALUK · Maṇṇūr — Karnataka
cells.place: Rectangular stone slab fixed in the exterior front wall of the Rāmaśvara temple about two miles from the village.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Stops after giving the titles of a feudatory whose name is lost. In characters of the 11th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / HASSAN DISTRICT / BELUA TALUK · HASSAN DISTRICT / BELUA TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hajēbid.—Pedestal of a broken image kept in the compound of the Hoysalćévara temple.
cells.remarks: Reads Rāchanana kīrtti... In characters of about the 11th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / HASSAN DISTRICT / BELUA TALUK · Kēdārēśvara temple, Halebid. — Karnataka
cells.place: Pedestal of a second image kept in the same compound.
cells.remarks: Damaged. States that the image of Pārśvanāthasvāmī was caused to be made by Tippōja, a disciple of Mallinētti, a lay-disciple of Nēmichandra-bhaṭṭāraka of [Mūla]-saṅgha, [Dēśiya]-gaṇa, Pustaka-gachchha and Koṇḍakuṇḍ-ānvaya. Do.

cells.location: MYSORE / HASSAN DISTRICT / BELUA TALUK · Kēdārēśvara temple, Halebid. † — Karnataka
cells.place: Pedestal of a third image in the same place. Findspot: Do.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Refers to Puṣpa-jinālaya. Do.

cells.location: MYSORE / MANDYA DISTRICT / NAGAMANGALA TALUK · MANDYA DISTRICT / NAGAMANGALA TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Nelligere.—Slab lying outside the dilapi-dated Bastiguđi temple.
cells.remarks: Contains an eulogy of Kāñchigaṇḍa Viṣṇuvardhana, enumerating his conquests. His son Narasimha I, to whose reign this record belongs, was the son of the Hoysaḷa king Chāḷuṅgi. Also contains a eulogy of his mahāmātya, Mahāpradhāna Dēvarāja and gives the succession of his Jaina gurus. Records that the Hoysaḷa ruler made a gift of the village Sōmanāthapura for the merit of the soul of his loyalty and that Dēvarāja, in his turn, caused the Pārśva jina bhavana to be built. The Hoysaḷa king also

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Chukankal.—Pillar in the ruined temple outside the village.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of gold to a local chaitya by the assembly (samaya) of Kopanamnātha and the nāḍu consisting of Sindavāḍi-nāḍu, Kaṇūr and Kōgali belonging to Ikalakere. In characters of about the 12th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab in the centre of the road leading to Muddaballi.
cells.remarks: Purport not clear. Mentions a number of persons such as Timmana-gauḍa, Singana-gauḍa, Hanamana-gauḍa, Baramana-gauḍa etc., and also the heggade of Hēvinahāl. In late characters.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Chunkankal † — Karnataka
cells.place: Another slab in the same place
cells.remarks: Purport not clear.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Halgēri — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab built into the katte in front of the Malli Gauḍa's house.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Mentions the mūryyāti of Kopana and [Am]garāja, the chief of Gitti, as being responsible for some gift (details lost). In characters of the 7th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone set up on the tank-bund outside the village.

cells.remarks: Records the death of Taḷāra-nāyaka Eyyamma in the battle of Channakalla-sime and the grant of land, apparently in his memory, by the mahājanas headed by the urodeya of Palgere.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Halgēri † — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone built into the floor of the Bhuvanēśvari temple.
cells.remarks: Partly built in. Seems to record the death of Barahmana (pārvva) (name illegible) belonging to Nalligiri. In characters of about the 8th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Halgēri † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying by the side of the Kallēśvara temple.

cells.remarks: Worn out and illegible. Mentions a makāmāya (name lost) and seems to record gifts of land.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Halgēri † — Karnataka
cells.place: Another slab lying in the same place
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Completely worn out and illegible. In characters of the 12th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Hosa-Gondahāl — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying in the outskirts of the village.
cells.remarks: Illegible. Purport not clear. Mentions Křishnarāya-mahārāya and Kopana. In late characters.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Irkalgadh — Karnataka
cells.place: Rook in the burning ghat outside the village.
cells.remarks: Worn out and illegible. In characters of about the 14th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Kiḍḍihāl — Karnataka
cells.place: Two slabs set up in front of the Hanumān temple.

cells.remarks: Records the gift of the village of Kiḍḍihāla situated in Kopana-vēṇṭe in Paḍuva-nāḍu by the king to the goddess Mahāmāyī of Hosabūra.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Koppal — Karnataka
cells.place: Rock called Chandra-bande within the limits of the Koppal fort.
cells.remarks: Records the completion of the row of sanyasins at the end of a long line of the Jaina teachers of the Mūlasaṅgha, Balātkāra-gaṇa, Sarasvatī-gachchha of the Kundakundānvaya. The inscription eulogises Sarvvanandi-bhaṭāra as having been a benefactor to the village (ur) and to the tīrtha. Published in the Kannaḍa Inscriptions of Koppal, p. 7, and Plate.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · MYSORE—concld. / RAICHUR DISTRICT—contd. / KOPPAL TALUK—contd. / Koppal—concld. — Karnataka
cells.place: Rock called Chandra-bande within the limits of the Koppal fort.
cells.remarks: Read: Śrī Apparasa amma... in characters of the 7th-8th century. Ibid., p. 7, and Plate.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Koppal † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying near a ruined maṇḍapa in a locality called Oṇikolla.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Only the imprecatory portion of the record is preserved. In characters of the 10th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Koppal † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying in front of the Assistant Commissioner's house.
cells.remarks: Do. Seems to record a gift of land to the deity Pārśvadēva at Pulvigo-agrahāra by Jātiseṭti, disciple of Chandra-siddhāntadēva, in the presence of the 500 (of Ay-yāvole) and the nakuras. Also refers to the consecration of a basadi built by Jātiseṭti and records gifts of oil etc., by other donors. In characters of the 12th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Koppal † — Karnataka
cells.place: Gavimaṭha rock, under a sculptured panel near the tank.
cells.date: Śaka 1268, Vyaya, Kārttika śu. 15, Monday = 1346, A. D., October 30.
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. Seems to record the construction of the niśidika of Simhanāth-āchārya, the disciple of the royal preceptor Annantakīrti by the devotees headed by the king himself.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Koppal † — Karnataka
cells.place: In the same place
cells.remarks: Reads: Dēva Mahāviṭu [mā] [ḍi]sida tēpu. In characters of the 16th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Koppal † — Karnataka
cells.place: Pillar in the Mahādēva temple
cells.remarks: Records a gift of three mattar of land by the heḍege of Gauridēvi to the basadi of Śāntalādēvi. While giving the boundaries of the gift-land the record refers to lands belonging to the basadi of Aṭṭimabbarasi. The gift was entrusted into the hands of the aṛuvar-dēśāri. In characters of about the 12th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Koppal † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in the Veṅkaṭēśa temple
cells.remarks: Records that the king's sōrdere bhaṇḍārada Timmaṇayya, son of Gōpaya, set up a lamp in the temple of Gōpīnātha at Sindogi, situated in Koppaṇa-sime which had been under his nāyakatana, for conducting services to the deity Chennakēśavadēva of Koppaṇa. Published in Kannada Inscriptions of Koppal, pp. 10-11, and Plate.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Koppal † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in front of the gate leading into the Gavimaṭha
cells.remarks: Seems to demarcate the boundry of the sarvamānya land belonging to the vīrakta-maṭha inside the fort. In late characters.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Koppal † — Karnataka
cells.place: Wall of a cave inside the Gavimaṭha
cells.remarks: Seems to mention a benefaction to Haṇpayya. Do.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Koppal † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in a field at the foot of the Palkigunḍu hill.
cells.remarks: Worn out and illegible. Mentions Kopala and the word pārvatya. Do.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Naregal — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab now kept in the Virappa temple.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Refers to the reign of a Pratāpa-Chakravartti and to his subordinate. In characters of about the 13th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Yettinahatti — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab built into the ruined huge.
cells.date: Śaka 1[1]17 (current) (chronogram), Āna-nda, Vaiśākha śu. 11, Tuesday = 1194 A.D., October 11.
cells.remarks: Records the death of the Jaina ascetic Ajitasēna of the Drāviḷa-saṅgha, by the observance of sallekhana during night on the date given. In characters of about the 12th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Javāli — Karnataka
cells.place: A well, 3 miles away from the village. Impression from the Superin-tendent, Arabic and Persian Inscriptions, Nagpur (Acc. No. 2672).
cells.remarks: Bilingual. Carelessly engraved. Records the construction [of the well] by Munshī Shāma Lāl, the Tahsildār of Nūrpura, by the orders of the Deputy Commissioner Śrī George Car Mebars (spelt as Jaraja Khāra Makabarasa). Mentions a sum of Rs. 1,000 probably as the cost of the construction of the well. For the Urdu portion see App.D. No. 292.

cells.location: Jodhpur — Rajasthan
cells.place: Stone in the Museum. Find-spot: Kusmā, Roodar Tahsil, Sirohi District.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Records the construction of a Śiva temple in the hermitage of the sage Kutsa, probably by a warrior named Satya-bhata. The eulogy was composed by Śivagupta and engraved by the Kehatriya Sthāvara, son of Rudravatsa. Published in Ep. Ind., Vol. XXXVI, pp. 47 ft. and Pl.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Amblārī — Karnataka
cells.place: Mahādēva temple. Stone built into the portico of the right hand shrine.
cells.date: Vikrama 1[6]19, Āśvina ba. 10, Monday = 1563 A.D. October 11. (Thē year was Kārtikādi and the month was Amānta).
cells.remarks: Indifferently engraved and damaged. Mentions the names of some persons belonging to the Dēvaḍā family as well as some śrāvakas.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / KOPPAL TALUK · Amblārī † — Karnataka
cells.place: Door lintel of the left hand shrine.
cells.date: Vikrama 1726 (current), Āśvina ba. 5, [Sunday] = 1669 A.D., October 3, f.d.t. .22. (The year was Kārtikādi and the month was Amānta).
cells.remarks: Seems to record that Chaudhari Diśā and some others had some structure erected in the temple of Mahādēva. Mentions Sūtradhāra Vārk dāsa.

cells.location: RAJASTHAN / SIROHI DISTRICT / SIROHI TAHSIL · RAJASTHAN—contd. / SIROHI DISTRICT—contd. / SIROHI TAHSIL—contd. / Āmblāri—contd. — Rajasthan
cells.place: Marble slab near an old dilapidated well in the field attached to 'Dūshiyā' arahaḥ.
cells.remarks: Seems to record a gift probably to a personnamed Śivadā-[sa...] who is described as sarvadhārin.

cells.location: RAJASTHAN / SIROHI DISTRICT / SIROHI TAHSIL · Amblārī † — Rajasthan
cells.place: Marble slab under a tamarind tree near ‘Dhibi’ arahat.

The order seems to have been issued following the representation by Malik-ush Sharq Malik Zāhid Beg to the nā’ib-i-ghāibat of the ma’āmala and was conveyed to the desā’is, the muqaddams, the khūts (khots) and also to the head collectors (beldar) of the region and of the island of Goa. The order further enjoins upon the men of Kokan (i.e. Konkan) region to refrain from accusing one another.

cells.location: GUJARAT AHMEDABAD TALUK — Gujarat
cells.remarks: Badly damaged. Records the death of . . . (name lost), son of Muhammad and grandson of Mitha Khan, who was the son of Shamu'd-Din and grandson of . . . Jalalu'd-Din. Date illegible. In characters of about the 17th century.

cells.location: GUJARAT AHMEDABAD TALUK — Gujarat
cells.remarks: Do. Illegible. Calligraphy same as in No. 71 above.

cells.location: GUJARAT AHMEDABAD TALUK — Gujarat
cells.remarks: States that this tomb of Maulānā Rāj, son of Dū'ūd and grandson of Muhammad, who was martyred on the first date by Muzaffar Shāh I (etc.), was constructed on the second date.

cells.location: GUJARAT AHMEDABAD TALUK — Gujarat
cells.remarks: Records the death of Shaun'd-Din, son of Ādam jī adib.

cells.location: GUJARAT AHMEDABAD TALUK — Gujarat
cells.remarks: Records the death of Fātimā Bāī, daughter of Mullā Ismā'īl jī and wife of Shaikh 'Abdu'l-Husain, son of Shaikh 'Abdu'l-Qādir Tāwārī.

cells.location: GUJARAT AHMEDABAD TALUK — Gujarat
cells.remarks: States that this grave is that of Miyān 'Alī Muhammad, son of Fīrūz and grandson of 'Ajab Shāh. Seems to have been set up in recent times.

cells.location: GUJARAT AHMEDABAD TALUK — Gujarat
cells.remarks: Contains a quatrain in praise of the saint Ahmad of Sarkhej. In characters of about the 17th century.

cells.location: GUJARAT AHMEDABAD TALUK — Gujarat
cells.remarks: Records the death of Rānī (i.e. queen) Rāj Bāī, alias Bā'ī Sultānī. Cf. M.A. Chaghtai, Musl. Mon. of Ahmadabad (Poona, 1941), p. 48, no. XH.

cells.location: GUJARAT AHMEDABAD TALUK — Gujarat
cells.remarks: States that Mīr Abu'l-Qāsim of noble lineage, who was entrusted with trusteeship (from the tomb of the saint) constructed a mosque on the road to Sarkhej (Sarkhej).

cells.location: GUJARAT AHMEDABAD TALUK — Gujarat
cells.place: Tughluq
cells.remarks: Persian, Naskh; Sanskrit, Nāgari. Bilingual. States that in accordance with an order issued to Malik Muzaffa by the king after the settlement of some issues, a mosque-and a well in the village (dih) Karakari in the district (a'māl) of Bađoda were constructed by Mokha Mehta, son of the Keta Mehta Hindi (i.e. Hindū). Published, Important Ins. Baroda State, Vol. II (Baroda, 1944), pp. 1-2, pl. I and corrected in Bul. Bar. Mus. Pic. Gal, Vol. XII (1955-56), pp. 33-35. For the Nāgari portion, see Imp. Ins. Bar. State, Vol. I, p. 16 and A. R. Ep., 1961-62, No. C 1311.

cells.location: GUJARAT AHMEDABAD TALUK — Gujarat
cells.place: Sulṭāns of Gujarat
cells.remarks: Do. Badly damaged. Purport not clear but seems to record some sort of royal order. Published, Ep. Ind. Ar. & Per. Suppl., 1963, p. 22, pl. VIIs For the Nāgari portion, see A. R. Ep., 1949-50, No. B 60.

cells.location: BHAVNAGAR TALUK · BHAVNAGAR TALUK Bhavnagar — Gujarat
cells.place: Gāndhī Smārak Musum. Loose slab. Findspot: Talājā, Talāja Taluk, Bhāvnagar District.
cells.remarks: Badly damaged. Records the construction of a mosque by Sayyid Šādiq, whose descent from Hadrat Sayyid Qutb-i-Ālam Bukhāri, son of Nāgiru'd-Dīn Mahṣūd and grandson of Makhdūm Jahāniyān Jahāngaḥt is quoted in full. Cf. Corpus Ins. Bhavnagari (Bhavnagar, 1889), p. 35.

cells.location: BHAVNAGAR TALUK · Not known — Gujarat
cells.place: Another slab.
cells.remarks: Bilingual. Badly damaged. Purport not clear but seems to record some sort of an order. Also mentions Malik Mujāhidu'l-Mulk. For the Nāgarī portion, see no. B 106.

cells.location: GOGHA TALUK · GOGHA TALUK Gōghā
cells.place: Loose slab in the compound of the Taluk Office.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary and badly damaged. Records the construction of a mosque by Mu'allim Bakhshū, son of Mu'allim Ḥusain. Written by (?) Shaik[h]ā, son of Dā'ūd.

cells.location: GOGHA TALUK · GOGHA TALUK Gōghā †
cells.place: Mosque in Maḥalla Bīrwīd. Headstone of a grave in the compound.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Epitaph, but name and date lost. In characters of the 16th century.

cells.location: GOGHA TALUK · Kharkad
cells.place: Tomb of Shaikh Abū Muḥammad Zakariyya. Left of the entrance.
cells.date:
(1) A.H. 566, Rama-dān 27, night of Friday=1171 A.D., June 3.
(2) A.H. 666, Safar 7=1267, A.D., Octōber 28.
cells.remarks: States that Bahāu'd-Dīn Abū'l-Barakāt Abū Muḥammad Zakariyya, son of Shaikh Bahāu'd-Dīn Zakariyya and grandson of Abū Bakr al-Quraishī, was born on the first date and that the name on the second date at the age of 100 years and that the name of his mother was Khātūn Bībī, daughter of Shaikh Bahāu'd-Dīn Zakariyya. The tomb of Shaikh Ruknu'd-Dīn Jiliānī. Date of writing not given, but evidently set up in about 1830 A.D. when the tomb was repaired. Cf. Corpus Ins. Bhav., p. 55.

cells.location: GOGHA TALUK · Kharkad †
cells.place: Headstone of a grave in the compound
cells.remarks: Records the death of Kabīr Muḥammad, son of Khūn[d] Shaikh.

cells.location: JUNAGADH DISTRICT JUNAGADH TALUK · JUNAGADH DISTRICT JUNAGADH TALUK Jumāgadh — Gujarat
cells.place: Khāprā Koḍiyā's Cave.
cells.remarks: States that Shaikh 'Alī, servant of the lofty court of (?) Ḥājī Muḥammad of Bhīyāna, had come to this place. Cf. J. Burgess, Report on the Ant. of Kāthiāwāḍ and Kachh, 1874-75 (London, 1876), p. 145.

cells.location: RAJKOT DISTRICT / GONDAL TALUK · RAJKOT DISTRICT / GONDAL TALUK — Gujarat
cells.place: Vasāvad.—Dargāh of Shāh Ghorī Velam Ghorī in the compound of the Jāmi' mosque. Near the headside of the main grave.
cells.remarks: States that this is the grave of Naşir, (son of) Mithā(?), entitled Khān-i-A'gam Ulugh Khān. In characters of about the early 16th century.

cells.location: SURAT DISTRICT / NAVSARI TALUK · SURAT DISTRICT / NAVSARI TALUK — Gujarat
cells.place: Navsāri.—Shāhī-Masjid. Western wall of the compound.
cells.remarks: Records the construction of the mosque by Muhammad Yazdī.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Dhār.—Dargāh near Barwāṇī-Masjid. Headstone of a grave.
cells.remarks: Records the martyrdom of four intimate friends, Khiṇr Khān, Mujāhid Khān, Burhān and Jalālu'd-Dīn who were killed after displaying feats of valour in a battle and were buried at Dhār in one place. Cf. Ep. Ind. Mosl., 1909-10, p. 16, pl. II, No. 3.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Dhār † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Dargāh of Pīr Bandī Chhor. In the central mihrāb of the one-wall mosque.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary and damaged. Contains religious text (Qur'ān, XXXVI, I-19). In characters of about the 15th century.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Dhār † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: To the right side of the above
cells.remarks: Contains the words Allāh and Muhammad and the date.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Dhār † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Maulānā Kamālu'd-Dīn's mosque (Bhoja-śālā). Around the central mihrāb.
cells.remarks: Contains Throne verse. In characters of about the 14th century.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Dhār † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Over the pulpit
cells.remarks: Contains religious text (Qur'ān, II, 55).

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Dhār † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: On the southern entrance
cells.remarks: Damaged. Contains First Creed and invocation to God, etc. In very late characters.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Dhār † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Maulānā Kamālu'd-Dīn's tomb. Blue-tile medallion over the entrance.
cells.remarks: Purport not clear.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · District Archaeological Museum — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Loose slab (Museum No. 134). (Estampage from old collection.)
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Contains a prayer (Du‘ā-i-Qadah). In characters of about the 16th century.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Māndū — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Dharmashālā near Hoshang Shāh's tomb. Fragmentary sarcophagus.
cells.remarks: Contains the First Creed. In very late characters.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Māndū † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Jāmi‘ mosque. Entrance
cells.remarks: Contains the Second Creed. Do.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Māndū † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Dargāh of Badr Shāh. Grave
cells.remarks: Contains religious text (Qur'ān, III, 185). Do.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Māndū † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Tomb of Mahmūd Shāh Khaljī. Sides of a fragmentary sarcophagus.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary and badly damaged. Records the demise of ‘Abdu'l...a'e-Siddīq.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · MADHYA PRADESH—contd. / DHAR DISTRICT—contd. / DHAR TAHSIL—contd. / Māpū—contd. — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Top of the sarcophagus of one of the two graves.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Contains the First Creed. In very late characters.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Māndū † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Nīlakaṇṭha temple. On the southern inner arch.
cells.remarks: Records the name of Shāh Badīgh Khān as the builder (‘āmi-ruhu). Cf. Ep. Ind. Mosl., 1909-10, p. 26.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Māndū † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Outer arch in the right wing.
cells.remarks: Records that the emperor passed through this place on his way to Dakan (Deccan). Written and engraved by Muham-mad Ma‘ṣūm Nāmi of Bakkar by residence and of Tirmidh by origin. Cf. ibid., p. 26, pl. XVI.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Māndū † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Rūpmati-kī-Chatrī. 1st storey, southern inner archway.
cells.remarks: Almost scrapped off. Purport not clear but the dynastic name Ghiyāth-i-Khilji is legible in characters of about the 16th century. Cf. ibid., p. 25.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Māndū † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Loose slab in Dharmashālā. (Estampage (in four pieces) from the old collection).
cells.remarks: Contains Quranic text (Qur’ān, LV, 27 and III, 185). In characters of about the 16th century.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Afzalpur — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Wall of a Bāorī near a mosque. (Estampage from the Superintendent, Archaeological Survey of India, Central Circle, Bhopal).
cells.remarks: Badly damaged. Illegible. In characters of about the 14th century.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Khilchīpur — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: ‘Ālamgīrī-Burj. Outer face.
cells.remarks: States that Ni‘mat Khān, son of Sālim Khān and grandson of Rahīm Khān of the Miyāna Afghān community, who had come from Ajmer and settled at Khilchīpur, constructed the burj (tower) and a bāorī.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Mandsaur — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Jāmi‘-Masjid in Bāzār Chauk. Over the central archway of the facade.
cells.remarks: Slightly damaged. Records the construction of the mosque by Sayyid Shāh ‘Alī, ṣāhib-i-juẓr (fief-holder) of the sarkār of Mandsaur.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Mandsaur † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Mōchiyōn-kī-Masjid in Bāzār Chauk. Over the central archway of the facade.
cells.remarks: Records the construction of the mosque.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Mandsaur † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Nāgaurī-Darwāza on the Qa‘la Road. Outer wall of the room on the east.
cells.remarks: Records the foundation of the Bāzār of Mandsaur, at the request of Benī Dās, by Mīrzā Momin, an official of Sarbaland Khān. Composed by Ghaibī (or Ghaibatī).

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Mandsaur † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Kunjon-ki-Masjid, same southern wall, outer face.
cells.language: Arabic prose and Persian Naskh and Nasta‘liq.
cells.remarks: Records the foundation of the mosque by Mīrzā Momin.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Mandsaur † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: On the main entrance
cells.language: Arabic prose and Persian Naskh and Nasta‘liq.
cells.remarks: States that the ruined mosque in the town was renovated by the vegetable-sellers (tarīfarūshān).

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Mandsaur † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Mosque near the gate of the fort.
cells.remarks: Contains First Creed, etc. in very late characters.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / DHAR TAHSIL · Mandsaur † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Another loose slab
cells.remarks: States that in Talehti, there was ono Nayak, Madh Khān by name, whose son Pīr Khān constructed at the chaukī, near the gate of the fort, a mosque for prayers.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / NIMACH TAHSIL · NIMACH TAHSIL — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Nīmach-Jāmi‘-Masjid. Over the main gate, left side.
cells.remarks: Records the construction of the eastern gate of the mosque.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / DHAR DISTRICT / NIMACH TAHSIL · NIMACH TAHSIL † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Right side
cells.remarks: Contains verses of a religious nature.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / RAJGARH DISTRICT / KHILCHIPUR TAHSIL · RAJGARH DISTRICT / KHILCHIPUR TAHSIL — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Khilchīpur-Jāmi‘-Masjid in Mahalla Pinjāriyān. Side wall of the staircase.
cells.date: A.H. 1273, Sha‘bān 19; Vikrama 1914, [Chaitra] ba. 6=1857 A.D., April 14.
cells.remarks: Bilingual. States that the mosque situated in Mahalla Gaujpūra at Kot-Khilchīpur was built during the government of Shāh ‘Ālam Sānī by list of the inhabitants of the town, the zamīndārs-i-mahallāt of the state and Rāi Fath Lālji, the kāmādār, by Miyān ‘Umar, son of Fīrūz, naddāf (cotton-carder) of Ghori community. For the Nāgarī portion, see App. B, No. 158.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / RAJGARH DISTRICT / KHILCHIPUR TAHSIL · RAJGARH DISTRICT / KHILCHIPUR TAHSIL † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Fort. Slab fixed against the wall of a house near the Top-Darwāza.
cells.remarks: Do. Records the oath of Chamund-Mātā and gō-hatyā (donkey-curse) taken by the Bāgarī community of Khilchīpur to the effect that they would pay their dues and that they would not henceforth break into the houses for theft, steal animals, grass, vegetable, etc., and indulge in similar activities. For the Nāgarī portion, see App. B, No. 159.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / RAJGARH DISTRICT / SARANGPUR TAHSIL · SARANGPUR TAHSIL — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Sārangpur-Pīr Zain Khān's Dargāh. Over the main entrance.
cells.date: A. H. 899, Rabī‘ I, 22=1493 A. D., December 31.
cells.remarks: Scrapped off. Seems to refer to the construction of a mosque. Names of the king and the builder and the date are lost. In characters of early 14th century A.D.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / RAJGARH DISTRICT / SARANGPUR TAHSIL · SARANGPUR TAHSIL † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Pahlwānōn-kī-Gumbad. Over the southern entrance.
cells.date: A. H. 899, Rabī‘ I, 22=1493 A. D., December 31.
cells.remarks: States that this madrasa (college) was constructed during the governorship of the great Khān and the glorious Khān Rustam Khān, muqtī of the shiq of Sārangpūra, by Malik-ul-Sharq Malik Bīdrāt Khālji (?) (Khalji?), the mujmādār.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / RAJGARH DISTRICT / SARANGPUR TAHSIL · MADHYA PRADESH—contd / RAJGARH DISTRICT—concld / SARANGPUR TAHSIL—contd — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Sārangpur—concld.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / RAJGARH DISTRICT / SARANGPUR TAHSIL · SARANGPUR TAHSIL † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Ma'sum Shah-ka-Gumbad near the Lal Gumbad, southern corner.
cells.remarks: Records that the emperor had camped at the place in the course of his march to Dakhan (Deccan). Written by Muhammad Ma'sum Nami of Bakkar.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / RAJGARH DISTRICT / SARANGPUR TAHSIL · SARANGPUR TAHSIL † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Fort. Baland-Darwaza. Northern side
cells.remarks: States that Malram, the kotwal repaired extensively the gateway of the fort of Sarangpur by Mahram the kotwal, under the order of Nawab Muhammad Sharif Khan.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / RAJGARH DISTRICT / SARANGPUR TAHSIL · SARANGPUR TAHSIL † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Southern side
cells.date: A. H. 996=1587-88 A.D. (chronogram) †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the reconstruction of the gateway of the fort of the city of Sarangpur by Mahram the kotwal, under orders of the governor). Written by Abn'l-Fath.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / RAJGARH DISTRICT / SARANGPUR TAHSIL · SARANGPUR TAHSIL † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Qal'a-ki-Masjid in the same place. Over the central mihrab.
cells.remarks: Records the construction of the mosque by Sayyid Khwaja Sabr, son of Khwaja-i-Hijri, better known as Nasri Khan under the supervision of Khwaja Khan. Written by Hafiz Shaikh Da'ud.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / RAJGARH DISTRICT / SARANGPUR TAHSIL · SARANGPUR TAHSIL † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Tomb of Dholan Shah or Dula Badshah. Loose slab (in two pieces).
cells.remarks: Scrapped off. Seems to refer to the construction of a minar (and/or) a mosque. In characters of the early 15th century.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / RAJGARH DISTRICT / SARANGPUR TAHSIL · SARANGPUR TAHSIL † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Another loose slab
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Refers to the grave of Babban. Part of the text perhaps identifies the name with Shajawal Khan Sur. In late characters.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / RAJGARH DISTRICT / SARANGPUR TAHSIL · SARANGPUR TAHSIL † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Slab fixed at the corner of a house in front of the Baland-Darwaza.
cells.remarks: Badly damaged. Seems to refer to the migration of the weavers (julahas) of Sarangpur (to some other place, or subjected to begar (free-labour), to other places, with the result that revenue fell. To rectify this state of affair, an order was issued by the emperor. In characters of about the 17th century.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / RAJGARH DISTRICT / SARANGPUR TAHSIL · SARANGPUR TAHSIL † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Slab fixed by the side of a grave in Tahsil Chauk.
cells.date: Regnal year 15, A.H. 1084, Jumada I, 15 = 1673 A.D., August 18.
cells.remarks: Records a royal order stopping the practice of compelling the weavers and grain-dealers to accept for sale the produce of crown-land (or land of officials) at a rate higher than the current one.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / RAJGARH DISTRICT / SARANGPUR TAHSIL · Sehore — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Step of the ghat on the river Siwan, locally called Ilahi Mata.
cells.date: A.H. 1308, Jumādā I, 2-1890 A. D., December 14.
cells.remarks: States that this ghat with a pucca wall was built for public use with the permission of the ruler of Bhopal by Seth Hamir.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / RAJGARH DISTRICT / SARANGPUR TAHSIL · Sehore † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place:
Jāmi-Masjid in Chhāonī. On the main entrance.

SHAJAPUR DISTRICT
cells.remarks: Chand, brother of Gambhir Chand and son of Mānik Chand, the eldest son of Bakhshi La'l and Kunwarji of the Sarāwagi community (got), residents of qagba Sihūr (and) of Mahalla Mōminpūra. Records the construction of the mosque by a minister, Imtiyāz by name, on the first date, while it was written on the second date. Composed by Amīr Mīnā'i Lakhnawi.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / RAJGARH DISTRICT / SHAJAPUR TAHSIL · SHAJAPUR TAHSIL — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Shajapur—Jami-Masjid. Over the central mihrab.
cells.remarks: Records the construction of the mosque by Mir.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / RAJGARH DISTRICT / SHAJAPUR TAHSIL — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Tomb of Mir Haidar 'Ali in the Da'ira Mahalla. On the main entrance.
cells.date: A. H. 1240, middle of Dhi'l-Qa'da, Saturday=1825 A. D., July 2.
cells.remarks: Records the death of Haidar 'Ali, a man of sword.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / RAJGARH DISTRICT / SHAJAPUR TAHSIL · SHAJAPUR TAHSIL † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Fort. Tagore Madhyamik Vidyalaya. Wall of the courtyard.
cells.language: Persian prose and verse, Nasta'liq; Hindi, Nagari.
cells.remarks: Records the death of Haidar 'Ali, a man of sword. Records the completion of the building of a school at Shajahanpur. For the Nagari portion, see Appendix B, No. 163 above.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / RAJGARH DISTRICT / SHUJALPUR TAHSIL · SHUJALPUR TAHSIL — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Shujalpur.—Graveyard in Talabpura. Headstone of a grave.
cells.remarks: Records the martyrdom of 'Azizu'llah.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / RAJGARH DISTRICT / SHUJALPUR TAHSIL · SHUJALPUR TAHSIL † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Takiya in Mahalla Banjipura. Loose slab
cells.date: A. H. 1237, Muharram 10=1821 A. D., October 7.
cells.remarks: States that from old times, the ta'ziya rites in the Janambara of Banjipura were performed by the forefathers of Chand, son of Banjipura Khan, Himmat Khan and Raja Khan and that for ensuring the continuance of the old practice it was decided at the time of (name illegible) that the family yearly amount (fixed by?) the gadi of the gadi in the faujdari will be utilised for the said purpose. Ends with an exhortation against violators of this arrangement and with an exhortation for regular performance of the ta'ziya of Hasnain.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / RAJGARH DISTRICT / SHUJALPUR TAHSIL · SHUJALPUR TAHSIL † — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Gongi-ka-Takiya. Sarcophagus of a grave
cells.remarks: Badly damaged. Seems to refer to the construction of the tomb of the deceased (name illegible) the mujahid-i-din Shaikh Ahmad Sardar Bahadur, jagirdar, resident of Aurangabad, who (presumably) suffered martyrdom. In characters of about the 18th century.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / TIKAMGARH DISTRICT / TIKAMGARH TASHIL · TIKAMGARH DISTRICT / TIKAMGARH TASHIL — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Tikamgarh.—Idgāh of Khān Bahādur
cells.remarks: States that the old mosque, built in a garden on the first date, was reconstructed on the second date.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / TIKAMGARH DISTRICT / TIKAMGARH TASHIL · TIKAMGARH DISTRICT / TIKAMGARH TASHIL — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Tikamgarh.—Idgāh of Khān Bahādur
cells.remarks: Contains verses in praise of Prophet Muhammad. In very late characters.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / UJJAIN DISTRICT / UJJAIN TAHSIL · MADHYA PRADESH—concld. / UJJAIN DISTRICT / UJJAIN TAHSIL — Madhya Pradesh
cells.place: Ujjain.—Binā Niv-ki-Masjid. Over the main entrance.
cells.remarks: Records the construction of the Jāmi' mosque by the king.

cells.location: MADHYA PRADESH / UJJAIN DISTRICT / UJJAIN TAHSIL · Ujjain † — Madhya Pradesh

cells.location: MADRAS SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT GINGEE TALUK / NAGAPATTANAM TALUK · NAGAPATTANAM TALUK Nāgūr † — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: MADRAS SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT GINGEE TALUK / NAGAPATTANAM TALUK · NAGAPATTANAM TALUK Nāgūr † — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Do. Language and execution crude. Records the construction of the tower in eleven stages (?) in the dargāh or Hādrat Qādir Sāhib, the saint, at Nagore-Bandar, which was carried out by the orders of the ruler. Also refers to the foundation of the Qādir-Penth near Tuljā-Mahārāj-Penth. Further mentions Mānoji Rāo the sarthai, Arnoji Rāo Bhōnslf, the governor (?) and Shaikh 'Abdu'l-Malik, the amīn (?). Genealogy of the ruler wrongly given in reverse order as: 'Umdatu'l-Mulk Rāja Mahārāj Ekoji son of Tuljā Mahārāj, son of Pratāp Singh. For the Marāthī portion, see Appendix B, No. 293.

cells.location: MADRAS SOUTH ARCOT DISTRICT GINGEE TALUK / TANJAVUR TALUK · TANJAVUR TALUK Tañjāvūr — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: DHULLA DISTRICT / NANDURBAR TALUK · DHULLA DISTRICT / NANDURBAR TALUK

cells.place: Kolhāpur—contd.

Contains the text of a roayl farmān granting the village Janja(?) along with Barakatābād(?) and Sirol in the pargana Rāybāg, formerly in the jāgīr of Farhād Khān, as reward(?) to Khān-i-A'zam NūrKhān for his services in suppressing the revolt of 'Ainu'l-Mulk. Also seems to mention 'Āli Janāb Rām Rāj (Vijayanagara king ?) and Veħatādrī Rāj. Cf. Jour. Univ. Bom., Vol. VIII (1939), pt. I, pp. 23-29. For the Marāṭhi and Kannađa portions, see Appendix B, No. 330.

cells.location: MAHARASHTRA / KOLHAPUR DISTRICT / KARVIR (KOLHAPUR) TALUK · MAHARASHTRA † — Maharashtra

cells.remarks: Bilingual. Cf. ibid., Vol. I (1933), p. 80. For the Marāṭhi portion, see Appendix B, No. 332.

cells.remarks: States that the foundation of this mosque was laid on the first date during the reign of Muḥammad Shāh, son of Fīrūz Shāh (Tughluq). It is further stated that the building materials of the temple in the mauḍa Sainthali, where Hindus used to assemble in large numbers every year and which was destroyed by the Khān on the representation of the qāḍī of the place, were used for the mosque. The inscription gives second date by Khān-i-A‘ẓam Khānzāda Ḥātim Khān and the dome of the entrance was built by Malik Qamar-i-Dīn under the superintendence of Muṣṭafā b. Dīn sar-kār-i-jāgīr-i-dīwān. Cf. Khwāja ‘Azīz. Cf. ibid., Vol. XX, pp. 131 32, plate XXXI.
